title: A stiffness ratio does not furnish enough interface shear capacity
statement: For perfect-composite bending, interface flow F*EA*abs(sum_(j<=i)y_j)/Bfull peaks at 1666.7819 N/m, or 83.3391 kPa across 20 mm width. Introduced friction .3 and pressure 100 kPa provide 30 kPa ideal capacity, corresponding to 1.79988 N tip load if full stick is required. Exceedance invalidates that full-stick claim; it does not solve slip or rule out other mechanisms. Collars every 20 mm need about 111.119 N normal force at the critical interface before margins, compliance and access. These are conditional requirements, not acquired clamps or electroadhesive fracture qualification.
